metadata.dc:title: Loss Aversion
metadata.dc:creator: Christophe Heubès
metadata.dc:description: Principle from prospect theory (Kahneman & Tversky): losses have roughly twice the psychological impact of equivalent gains.
metadata.dc:subject: Biases & Heuristics, concept, illustration, christophe.heubes.com

svg.text: Losing $100 hurts more than gaining $100 feels good.

g.text: IT TAKES TWO GAINS TO OFFSET ONE LOSS
